what: dmx 0.3.0 against OrbStack, Colima and Docker Desktop on one quiet Mac (macOS 26.6.1, M4, 10 cores, 16 GB), one engine at a time, three rounds in alternating order, 2 CPUs and a 4 GiB ceiling each, no host shares. Idle memory is sampled at 35, 50, 65, 80 and 95 s after the image pull, so each engine is read both at the 35 s mark every earlier comparison used and at its steady state.

engines.orbstack: OrbStack 2.2.5 (21124), Docker 29.8.2, headless (orbctl start); setup.use_admin and docker.set_context off
engines.docker-desktop: Docker Desktop 4.96.3 (244472), Docker 29.9.2, Apple Virtualization framework, Resource Saver left on (its default); EnableDefaultDockerSocket, RequireVmnetd and EnablePrivilegedPorts off and CLI tools in ~/.docker/bin, which avoids password prompts and does not change memory reclamation

installers.note: the same files as the 2026-10-26 comparison, by sha256; Colima from Homebrew

memory_return_probes.note: 2 GiB in a container tmpfs, freed, then the footprint sampled past the benchmark's 10 s limit

docker-desktop_long.note: same probe continued: 3117 MB at five minutes, then Resource Saver stops the VM and the footprint is 258 MB (the app's own processes) from six minutes on
